changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.6.5:

• 🌐 WebSocket Stability & Proactive GoAway Auto-Reconnect: Fixed spurious 'Software caused connection abort' popups during routine session renewals and Google GoAway handshakes; old superseded socket callbacks are now safely ignored.

• 📱 Live Screen Sharing Vision: Gemini Live multimodal video streaming with real-time video schema and Android 14 MediaProjection foreground service compliance.

• 🔇 Zero Mic Blinking: Hardware microphone capture remains continuous and rock-solid during background standby.
